<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Tomasz Wietrzykowski - AI & Software Portfolio</title>
  <link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="images/favicon.png" />
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com" />
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Space+Mono:ital,wght@0,400;0,700;1,400&family=DM+Sans:wght@300;400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet" />
  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #0a0b0e;
      --surface: #111318;
      --surface2: #181c23;
      --border: #1f2430;
      --accent: #00e5a0;
      --accent2: #4f8cff;
      --accent3: #ff6b6b;
      --accent4: #ffd166;
      --text: #e8eaf0;
      --muted: #6b7280;
      --mono: 'Space Mono', monospace;
      --sans: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    }

    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

    body {
      background: var(--bg);
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: var(--sans);
      line-height: 1.6;
      overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    /* ─── NOISE OVERLAY ─── */
    body::before {
      content: '';
      position: fixed; inset: 0;
      background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.9' numOctaves='4' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='0.04'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
      pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; opacity: .35;
    }

    /* ─── HEADER ─── */
    header {
      position: relative;
      padding: 80px 24px 70px;
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0 48px;
    }
    .header-left {
      grid-column: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .header-photo {
      grid-column: 2;
      align-self: center;
      width: 400px;
      aspect-ratio: 1/1;
      border-radius: 6px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,160,0.22);
      box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0,229,160,0.09), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
      flex-shrink: 0;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    .header-photo img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      object-position: center 15%;
      display: block;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 2;
    }
    @media (max-width: 700px) {
      header { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .header-photo { grid-column: 1; width: 100%; max-width: 300px; margin: 32px auto 0; }
    }

    .header-grid-bg {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      z-index: 0;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, var(--border) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 48px 48px;
      opacity: .4;
      mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 0%, black, transparent);
    }

    .badge {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      border: 1px solid var(--accent);
      padding: 4px 12px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      position: relative;
    }

    h1 {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 6vw, 5rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -.02em;
      line-height: 1.05;
      position: relative;
    }

    h1 span.accent { color: var(--accent); }
    h1 span.dim { color: var(--muted); }

    .subtitle {
      margin-top: 20px;
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      color: var(--muted);
      max-width: 560px;
      font-weight: 300;
      position: relative;
    }

    .header-stats {
      display: flex;
      gap: 32px;
      margin-top: 40px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      position: relative;
    }

    .stat {
      font-family: var(--mono);
    }
    .stat-num {
      font-size: 2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      line-height: 1;
    }
    .stat-label {
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    /* ─── NAV ─── */
    nav {
      position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 100;
      background: rgba(10, 11, 14, 0.88);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 0 24px;
    }
    .nav-inner {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      overflow-x: auto;
      scrollbar-width: none;
      padding: 12px 0;
    }
    .nav-inner::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .nav-btn {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--muted);
      background: none;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      transition: all .2s;
    }
    .nav-btn:hover, .nav-btn.active {
      color: var(--accent);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(0,229,160,.06);
    }

    /* ─── MAIN ─── */
    main {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 60px 24px 120px;
    }

    /* ─── SECTION ─── */
    .section { margin-bottom: 80px; }

    .section-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 36px;
      padding-bottom: 20px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }

    .section-icon {
      font-size: 1.6rem;
      line-height: 1;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }

    .section-meta {}
    .section-tag {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 6px;
    }

    h2 {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: -.01em;
    }

    .section-desc {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: .9rem;
      margin-top: 6px;
      font-weight: 300;
    }

    /* ─── GRID ─── */
    .grid {
      display: grid;
      gap: 20px;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr));
    }
    .grid.wide {
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(480px, 1fr));
    }

    /* ─── CARD ─── */
    .card {
      background: var(--surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      overflow: hidden;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      transition: border-color .25s, transform .25s, box-shadow .25s;
      position: relative;
    }
    .card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,229,160,.08);
    }

    .card-accent-line {
      height: 2px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), transparent);
    }
    .card-accent-line.blue { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent2), transparent); }
    .card-accent-line.red  { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent3), transparent); }
    .card-accent-line.gold { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent4), transparent); }

    .card-body {
      padding: 22px;
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }

    .card-num {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 10px;
      color: var(--muted);
      letter-spacing: .1em;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

    .card h3 {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .card p {
      font-size: .875rem;
      color: #9ca3af;
      line-height: 1.65;
      flex: 1;
      font-weight: 300;
    }

    .card-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 16px;
    }

    .tag {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,.04);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      color: var(--muted);
    }

    .card-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 10px;
      margin-top: 18px;
      padding-top: 16px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      text-decoration: none;
      padding: 7px 14px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      border: 1px solid;
      transition: all .2s;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .btn-primary {
      color: var(--accent);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      background: rgba(0,229,160,.06);
    }
    .btn-primary:hover {
      background: rgba(0,229,160,.15);
    }
    .btn-secondary {
      color: var(--muted);
      border-color: var(--border);
      background: transparent;
    }
    .btn-secondary:hover {
      color: var(--text);
      border-color: var(--muted);
    }
    .btn-blue {
      color: var(--accent2);
      border-color: var(--accent2);
      background: rgba(79,140,255,.06);
    }
    .btn-blue:hover { background: rgba(79,140,255,.15); }

    /* ─── FEATURED CARD ─── */
    .card.featured {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      flex-direction: row;
      gap: 0;
    }
    .card.featured .card-accent-line {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      height: 2px;
    }
    .card.featured .card-body {
      flex: 1;
    }
    .card.featured .featured-badge {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      border: 1px solid var(--accent);
      padding: 2px 8px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    /* ─── METRICS ROW ─── */
    .metrics {
      display: flex;
      gap: 20px;
      margin-top: 14px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .metric {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
    }
    .metric strong {
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    /* ─── FOOTER ─── */
    footer {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      padding: 40px 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    footer p {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      letter-spacing: .05em;
    }
    footer a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; }

    /* ─── ANIMATIONS ─── */
    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }
    .section { animation: fadeUp .6s ease both; }
    .section:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: .1s; }
    .section:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: .2s; }
    .section:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: .3s; }
    .section:nth-child(4) { animation-delay: .4s; }
    .section:nth-child(5) { animation-delay: .5s; }

    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .card.featured { flex-direction: column; }
      .grid.wide { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    /* ===== GALLERY ===== */
    .card-gallery {
      position: relative;
      aspect-ratio: 16/9;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #0a0a0a;
    }
    .card-gallery img {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.8s;
    }
    .card-gallery img.active {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .gallery-btn {
      position: absolute;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.55);
      border: none;
      color: #fff;
      font-size: 18px;
      width: 32px;
      height: 48px;
      cursor: pointer;
      z-index: 10;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.2s;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      border-radius: 3px;
    }
    .card-gallery:hover .gallery-btn {
      opacity: 1;
    }
    .gallery-btn.prev { left: 6px; }
    .gallery-btn.next { right: 6px; }
    .gallery-dots {
      position: absolute;
      bottom: 6px;
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      display: flex;
      gap: 5px;
      z-index: 10;
    }
    .gallery-dot {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.2s;
    }
    .gallery-dot.active {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.9);
    }

    /* ===== SOCIAL FOOTER ===== */
    .social-footer {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
      padding: 28px 24px;
    }
    .social-footer-inner {
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 12px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .social-link {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 9px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 4px;
      color: var(--muted);
      text-decoration: none;
      font-size: 13px;
      font-family: var(--mono);
      transition: border-color .2s, color .2s;
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .social-link:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--fg);
    }
    .social-link img {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      object-fit: cover;
      border-radius: 3px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .social-link svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      opacity: 0.7;
    }
    .social-sep {
      color: var(--border);
      font-size: 18px;
      user-select: none;
    }

    /* ===== TOOLS SECTION ===== */
    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(320px, 1fr));
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .tool-card {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 6px;
      padding: 18px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: border-color .2s, transform .2s;
    }
    .tool-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent2);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }
    .tool-card-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .tool-icon {
      font-size: 20px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .tool-name {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 13px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--fg);
    }
    .tool-desc {
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
      flex: 1;
    }
    .tool-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 4px;
    }
    .btn-tool {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      border: 1px solid var(--accent2);
      color: var(--accent2);
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: background .2s, color .2s;
    }
    .btn-tool:hover {
      background: var(--accent2);
      color: #000;
    }

    /* ===== PRODUCTION SYSTEM CARD ===== */
    .production-card {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,160,0.25);
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: 0 0 40px rgba(0,229,160,0.05);
    }
    .production-header {
      padding: 28px 28px 20px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    }
    .production-badge {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 10px;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      border: 1px solid var(--accent);
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: 2px;
      display: inline-block;
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .production-title {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.5vw, 1.6rem);
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--fg);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .production-desc {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 1rem;
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 780px;
    }
    .production-desc + .production-desc {
      margin-top: 10px;
    }
    .modules-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: 1px;
      background: var(--border);
    }
    .module-item {
      background: var(--card);
      padding: 18px 22px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .module-item:hover {
      background: rgba(0,229,160,0.03);
    }
    .module-name {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 12px;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: .05em;
    }
    .module-detail {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .production-footer {
      padding: 18px 28px;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .production-tags {
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .production-note {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--muted);
      letter-spacing: .05em;
    }

    /* ===== ABOUT SECTION ===== */
    .about-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 32px;
      align-items: start;
    }
    @media (max-width: 700px) { .about-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

    .about-bio {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 28px;
    }
    .about-bio h4 {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 14px;
    }
    .about-bio p {
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.75;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .about-bio p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

    .timeline {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 28px;
    }
    .timeline h4 {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 18px;
    }
    .timeline-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      position: relative;
    }
    .timeline-item:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
    .timeline-item::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 46px;
      top: 22px;
      bottom: -18px;
      width: 1px;
      background: var(--border);
    }
    .timeline-item:last-child::before { display: none; }
    .timeline-year {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      color: var(--accent);
      min-width: 40px;
      padding-top: 2px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .timeline-dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--accent);
      margin-top: 5px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .timeline-content strong {
      display: block;
      font-size: 13px;
      color: var(--fg);
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }
    .timeline-content span {
      font-size: 12px;
      color: var(--muted);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .open-to-box {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(0,229,160,0.05), rgba(0,163,255,0.05));
      border: 1px solid rgba(0,229,160,0.2);
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 22px 28px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .open-to-label {
      font-family: var(--mono);
      font-size: 11px;
      letter-spacing: .15em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .open-to-tags {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .open-to-tag {
      font-size: 12px;
      font-family: var(--mono);
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--accent2);
      color: var(--accent2);
      border-radius: 3px;
    }

    .stack-row {
      grid-column: 1 / -1;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--border);
      border-radius: 8px;

      <div class="research-title">Anatomical Heterogeneity in Transformer Language Models</div>
      <div class="research-meta">Tomasz Wietrzykowski · Independent Researcher, Wrocław, Poland · March 2026</div>
      <p class="research-abstract">
        Current transformer models train all layers with uniform computational budgets, implicitly assuming layer homogeneity. This paper challenges that assumption through comprehensive empirical analysis of SmolLM2-135M (30 layers, 135M parameters), introducing diagnostic metrics including weight predictability (R²), layer-wise ablation degradation, post-perturbation recovery speed, and weight manipulation robustness.
      </p>
      <div class="research-findings">
        <div class="finding-item">
          <strong>Critical Core</strong>
          Layers 8–11 form a dominant reasoning core - ablation causes up to +63,419% perplexity degradation.
        </div>
        <div class="finding-item">
          <strong>Anti-Layers</strong>
          Layers L14 and L17 have net-negative contribution - removing them <em>improves</em> model performance.
        </div>
        <div class="finding-item">
          <strong>Oscillatory Pattern</strong>
          Layer weights follow a universal oscillatory delta pattern (inter-layer correlation ≈ −0.50), yet regression-based weight generation fails catastrophically.
        </div>
        <div class="finding-item">
          <strong>Growth Transformer Training</strong>
          Proposed training paradigm allocating budget by empirical layer importance achieves 4.7× lower validation loss vs. uniform baseline, 13% faster, identical parameter count.
        </div>
        <div class="finding-item">
          <strong>Recovery Speed</strong>
          Post-perturbation recovery speed correlates with layer importance - a practical proxy for per-layer training budget requirements.
        </div>
        <div class="finding-item">
          <strong>Reproducible</strong>
          All experiments run on free Kaggle GPU (NVIDIA T4). No proprietary data or licensed resources.

  const obs = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {

        navBtns.forEach((b,i) => b.classList.toggle('active', i === idx));

    });
  }, { rootMargin: '-30% 0px -60% 0px' });

  sections.forEach(s => obs.observe(s));

<script>
(function(){
  document.querySelectorAll('.card-gallery').forEach(function(gallery){
    var imgs = gallery.querySelectorAll('img');
    if(imgs.length <= 1) return;
    var idx = 0;
    var dots = gallery.querySelectorAll('.gallery-dot');
    function show(n){
      imgs[idx].classList.remove('active');
      dots[idx].classList.remove('active');
      idx = (n + imgs.length) % imgs.length;
      imgs[idx].classList.add('active');
      dots[idx].classList.add('active');
    }
    // autoplay - każda galeria startuje z losowym offsetem żeby nie zmieniały się wszystkie naraz
    var delay = 3200 + Math.random() * 1400;
    var timer = setInterval(function(){ show(idx + 1); }, delay);
    // po ręcznym kliknięciu reset timera
    function resetTimer(){
      clearInterval(timer);
      timer = setInterval(function(){ show(idx + 1); }, delay);
    }
    gallery.querySelector('.gallery-btn.prev').addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.stopPropagation(); show(idx-1); resetTimer();
    });
    gallery.querySelector('.gallery-btn.next').addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.stopPropagation(); show(idx+1); resetTimer();
    });
    dots.forEach(function(dot, i){
      dot.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); show(i); resetTimer(); });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
